InstallFiles: Copy and verify release files for the background service and desktop interface.
InstallRegistry: Register the product path in HKLM and App Paths so the launcher can locate the program and Windows can find it.

InstallShortcuts: Create Start menu shortcuts for all users for the main program and update manager, enabling Windows search and manual taskbar pinning.

Heading: Update management
Intro: Update, recover, or repair Resource Manager. Review the actions before proceeding.
VersionRules: Updates require a newer version; repairs require the installed version's release package. Both preserve user data and a backup of the old directory.
PackageActions: The manager waits for desktop sessions to exit, stops the service, verifies and backs up the old directory, replaces program files, starts the service, and checks its status. On failure it attempts to restore the old program and data. Administrator rights are required; first exit Resource Manager from the tray.
RecoveryActions: Using the interrupted transaction record, the manager stops the service, preserves the unfinished new directory as a failed copy, restores the old program and original data, and tries to restart the previous service. Administrator rights are required; first exit Resource Manager from the tray.
SelfReplaceNotice: If the release includes a newer manager, closing this window completes its replacement.
ManagerPathUnknown: Unable to determine the manager executable path.
ManagerChildFailed: The elevated updater did not start.
OperationFailed: The operation did not complete. Check the transaction records in the update directory, or reopen the manager and use recovery.
OperationSucceeded: Operation completed. The manager retained a backup of the original directory.
NotInstalled: Resource Manager is not installed. Use Install.exe for the first installation.
